strings.Ae-ToolKit 是一款完全离线运行的 After Effects 工具面板: Ae-ToolKit is an offline After Effects toolkit for project organization, expressions and scripts. Windows uses AEGP + WebView2; macOS retains CEP. Supports AE 2023+. Open source and local first.
strings.0.5.1 起，Windows 使用 AEGP + WebView2。关闭 AE: Starting with 0.5.1, Windows uses AEGP + WebView2. Close AE, run the installer as administrator and select the target AE
strings.文件夹；程序安装到其: folder. The panel is installed under
strings.。向导先备份数据，再迁移旧 CEP 设置与方案；已有原生数据优先。旧 CEP 和: . The installer backs up data before migrating legacy CEP settings and schemes. Existing native data takes priority. Legacy CEP and personal scripts are retained; no prior uninstall is needed.
strings.文件夹整体复制到 macOS 的 CEP 扩展目录，复制时需要管理员权限。避免同: folder into the macOS CEP extensions directory with administrator permission. Avoid duplicate copies with the same extension ID:
strings.# macOS 终端\ndefaults write com.adobe.CSX:
# macOS Terminal
defaults write com.adobe.CSXS.11 PlayerDebugMode -bool true
strings.新增动画耗时倍率：2x 保持原版速度，默认 1x 更快，另有 0.5x 和关闭，: Add animation duration scales: 2x keeps the original timing, the faster 1x is the default, with 0.5x and Off also available. Respect system reduced motion.
strings.表达式分类改为可编辑标签，支持多个标签、清空标签及旧分类兼容。: Replace expression categories with editable tags, including multiple tags, untagged presets and legacy category compatibility.
strings.表达式支持分别按名称和标签筛选，也可同时使用两个筛选条件。: Filter expressions by name, by tag, or by both at once.
strings.临时关闭 TSF 输入路径以复测微软拼音兼容性；候选窗定位问题仍在排查。: Temporarily disable the TSF input path to retest Microsoft Pinyin compatibility. Candidate window positioning remains under investigation.
strings.工程整理新增可搜索目录树与逐级新建；后缀和忽略合成名称按 Enter 生成可移除: Add a searchable organizer folder tree with nested folder creation. Press Enter to turn extensions and ignored composition names into removable tags.
strings.重做方案保存交互，区分内置预设与个人方案，提示未保存修改，并完善中英文与小面板布: Clarify scheme saving with separate built-in presets and personal schemes, unsaved-change prompts, bilingual copy and compact layouts.
strings.Ae-ToolKit — After Effects 离线扩展工具集: Ae-ToolKit — Offline tools for After Effects
strings.Ae-ToolKit 是一款完全离线运行的 After Effects CEP: Ae-ToolKit is a fully offline After Effects CEP panel with project organization, expression management, and a script launcher. Supports AE 2023+. Free and open source, with a local-first approach.
strings.切换亮色 / 暗色主题: Switch between light and dark themes
strings.整理工程、复用表达式、启动常用脚本。: Organize projects, reuse expressions, and launch your go-to scripts.
strings.你熟悉的工作流，集中在一个离线面板。: Your familiar workflow, together in one offline panel.
strings.交互式 AE工具箱 Logo：移动指针散开粒子，点击或按回车产生涟漪: Interactive AE Toolkit logo: move the pointer to scatter particles; click or press Enter to create a ripple
strings.整理、表达式、脚本集。把重复操作收好，让创作自然往前。: Organization, expressions, and scripts. Keep repetitive tasks in order and let creativity move forward.
strings.图像、视频和音频素材按类型自动归入文件夹: Images, video, and audio are automatically sorted into folders by type
strings.按自己的规则，把素材放回熟悉的位置。保存多套整理方案，下一个工程直接复用。: Put assets where you expect them, with rules of your own. Save multiple organization presets and reuse them in your next project.
strings.一段表达式同步应用到位置、旋转和缩放三个属性: One expression applied to Position, Rotation, and Scale together
strings.选好属性，挑选或编写表达式，一次应用到多处。覆盖前确认，常用代码随手保存。: Select properties, choose or write an expression, and apply it in one go. Confirm before overwriting, and save your frequently used code.
strings.本地脚本按名称展示，常用脚本可收藏并快速启动: Local scripts listed by name, with favorites and quick launch
strings.把常用脚本留在自己的目录。搜索、收藏、双击运行，图片会从脚本集的 image 文: Keep your favorite scripts in your own folders. Search, favorite, and double-click to run. Images are matched automatically from the script library’s image folder.
strings.更顺手的操作，也更方便带走的工作环境。: Smoother operation. A workspace that is easier to take with you.
strings.团队猫耳角色双手扒着更新卡片: The team’s cat-eared mascot holding onto the update card
strings.设置、收藏、表达式和整理预设统一保存。拷走扩展文件夹，就带走熟悉的工作环境。: Settings, favorites, expressions, and organization presets are saved together. Copy the extension folder to take your familiar workspace along.
strings.紧凑脚本列表、拖动滚动、方向切页与轻量收藏动画，让每一次操作更自然。: A compact script list, drag scrolling, directional page transitions, and subtle favorite animations make each interaction feel more natural.
strings.新版安装器先备份，再更新程序。无需先卸载，个人设置和预设会保留。: The new installer backs up your data before updating program files. No need to uninstall first: personal settings and presets are kept.
strings.开源，也方便接着做: Open source. Ready to build on.
strings.原生 JavaScript 与 ExtendScript。以下是 API 调用示: Native JavaScript and ExtendScript. These are API usage examples; the panel needs no frontend runtime installation.
strings.；安装包仅包含程序和内置默认数据。: ; the package contains only program files and built-in defaults.
strings.阅读架构与维护说明 ↗: Read the architecture and maintenance guide ↗
strings.几步，接入你的 AE。: A few steps to your AE.
strings.支持 After Effects 2023 及更新版本。Windows 推荐安装: Supports After Effects 2023 and later. The Windows installer is recommended; macOS uses manual installation.
strings.：本工具会在本地写入文件（整理素材、保存方案与自定义表达式），需开启 AE 脚本: : This tool writes local files to organize assets and save presets and custom expressions. Enable script write access in After Effects 2023+:
strings.编辑 → 首选项 → 脚本与表达式 → 勾选「允许脚本写入文件和访问网络」: 编辑 → 首选项 → 脚本与表达式 → 勾选「允许脚本写入文件和访问网络」
strings.重启 After Effects 使设置生效。工具的核心功能离线运行；此选项用于: Restart After Effects for the setting to take effect. The core tools work offline; this option allows local file writing.
strings.更新前关闭 AE，直接运行新版安装器，无需卸载。向导先备份数据，再更新程序，设置: Close AE before updating, then run the new installer without uninstalling first. The wizard backs up data before updating program files, keeping settings and presets in the extension folder. Installation uses the system-wide CEP directory and requires administrator approval. Data from an old user-level installation is migrated and backed up. For an unsigned development package, select development mode on the components page.
strings.按提示重启 After Effects，通过菜单路径打开面板：: Restart After Effects as prompted, then open the panel from:
strings.安装前请核对下载来源与版本，按组织的安装策略处理系统提示。: Check the download source and version before installing, and follow your organization’s installation policy when responding to system prompts.
strings.文件夹整体复制到 CEP 扩展目录。统一使用以下系统级目录，复制时需要管理员权限: folder into the CEP extensions directory. Use the system-wide paths below; administrator privileges are required. Avoid keeping multiple copies of the extension with the same ID:
strings.# Windows 系统级\nC:\\Program Files (x86)\\:
# Windows — system-wide
C:\Program Files (x86)\Common Files\Adobe\CEP\extensions\

# macOS — system-wide
/Library/Application Support/Adobe/CEP/extensions/
strings.手动复制后，给扩展内: After copying manually, give the current user Modify permission on the extension’s
strings.文件夹设置当前用户的修改权限，供设置与预设保存。Windows 安装器会自动处理: folder so settings and presets can be saved. The Windows installer handles this permission automatically.
strings.未签名开发包需开启对应 CEP 版本的调试模式。AE 2023/2024 使用: Unsigned development packages require debug mode for the matching CEP version. AE 2023/2024 uses CSXS.11; AE 2025 and later uses CSXS.12. Signed CEP extensions do not need this setting:
strings.# Windows 注册表（当前用户，字符串值）\nHKEY_CURRENT_U:
# Windows registry (current user, string value)
HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Adobe\CSXS.11\PlayerDebugMode = 1

# macOS Terminal
defaults write com.adobe.CSXS.11 PlayerDebugMode -bool true
strings.重启 After Effects 后，通过菜单路径打开面板：: Restart After Effects, then open the panel from:
strings.为日常创作，做一点顺手的工具。: A few handy tools for everyday creativity.
strings.返回页面顶部: Back to the top of the page
strings.当前 Windows 安装器未进行代码签名。若出现“Windows 已保护你的电: The current Windows installer is not code-signed. If Windows displays “Windows protected your PC”, confirm that the installer came from this project’s GitHub Releases, then click “More info” → “Run anyway” to continue.
strings.语法高亮、行号与错误定位，配合括号补全和自动缩进，让代码更清楚。: Syntax highlighting, line numbers and error locations, with bracket completion and automatic indentation, make code easier to read.
strings.一键排版，随时撤销: Format in one click. Undo in one step.
strings.点击格式化或按 Shift+Alt+F，整理缩进、空格与换行；一次撤销即可恢复原: Click Format or press Shift+Alt+F to tidy indentation, spacing and line breaks. Undo once to restore your draft.
strings.设置中选择简体中文或 English，切换后保留草稿与撤销历史，重开仍记得你的选: Choose Simplified Chinese or English in Settings. Keep drafts and undo history when switching, and remember your choice after reopening.
strings.高亮编辑、语法检查、一键格式化，写好表达式再批量应用。设置中可随时切换中英界面。: Write expressions with syntax highlighting, syntax checks and one-click formatting, then apply them in batches. Switch between Chinese and English in Settings.
strings.写表达式更顺手，中英界面随时切换。: A better expression editor. Chinese and English, ready to switch.
strings.Windows 新增 AEGP + WebView2 原生面板，微软拼音候选窗跟: Add a Windows AEGP + WebView2 panel with Microsoft Pinyin candidates following the caret. Retain CEP on macOS.
strings.新增按平台自动构建与发布流程：Windows 原生安装器支持备份迁移旧 CEP: Add platform build and release automation: the Windows native installer backs up and migrates legacy CEP data, while macOS receives a CEP ZIP. Verify versions and SHA-256 checksums.
strings.按你的需要，选择一条清楚的阅读路线。: Choose the guide that fits what you want to do.
strings.安装与更新、工程整理、批量表达式、本地脚本集，以及数据备份与常见问题。: Installation, updates, project organization, batch expressions, local scripts, backups, and common questions.
strings.了解项目架构、Host 桥接接口、数据约定和测试构建，在现有工具上继续开发。: Explore the architecture, Host bridge, data conventions, tests, and builds to extend the toolkit.
strings.仅选中图层时，可自选锚点、位置、缩放、旋转、不透明度及 3D 方向与旋转等变换目: When only layers are selected, batch-apply expressions to chosen transforms such as Anchor Point, Position, Scale, Rotation, Opacity and 3D Orientation/Rotation. Remember target choices.
strings.补全弹层和整理目录选择弹窗新增进出动画，统一跟随动画耗时倍率与系统减少动态效果设: Animate completion and organizer folder popups on entry and exit, following the animation duration scale and system reduced motion setting.
strings.整理方案新增放弃修改并还原；保存和还原按钮仅在有未保存修改时显示，非安静模式下还: Add discard and restore for organizer schemes. Show save and restore actions only for unsaved changes, and confirm restoration unless Quiet mode is enabled.
strings.新增离线表达式代码补全，覆盖常用 AE 全局对象、函数、对象成员、JavaScr: Add offline expression completion for common AE globals, functions, object members, JavaScript entries and draft variables.
strings.设置页独立表达式编辑分组，补全与说明默认开启；接受候选按键可选 Enter 或: Add a dedicated expression editor settings section. Completion and help default on; choose Enter or Tab to accept suggestions, with Enter as the saved default.
strings.内置函数显示精简功能、参数数量、参数含义及可选默认值；补全时自动补括号，支持鼠标: Show concise built-in function descriptions, argument counts, parameter meanings and optional defaults. Insert function parentheses and support mouse selection and single-step undo.
strings.补全弹层沿用深灰与蓝色主题，适配小面板和中英界面；注释、字符串、只读及输入法选词: Match the dark gray and blue theme, compact panels and both UI languages. Suppress suggestions in comments, strings, read-only mode and IME composition.
strings.仅选中图层时，可自选变换目标批量应用表达式，勾选立即生效；默认空选，同次会话保留: When only layers are selected, batch-apply expressions to chosen transforms. Choices take effect immediately, start empty and last only until the panel reloads.
strings.新增离线表达式代码补全，从首字母开始匹配，输入和删除时持续更新，最多展示最匹配的: Add offline expression completion from the first letter. Refresh suggestions while typing or deleting and show up to seven best matches.
strings.补全覆盖常用 AE 全局对象、内置函数、成员链、JavaScript 常用项与当: Complete common AE globals, built-in functions, member chains, JavaScript entries and draft variables. Insert function parentheses with single-step undo.
strings.内置函数与属性提供精简双语帮助，展示用途、参数数量与含义、必填/可选参数和默认值: Show concise bilingual function and property help, including purpose, argument counts and meanings, required/optional parameters and defaults.
strings.新增独立的表达式编辑设置，补全和说明默认开启；接受候选按键可选 Enter 或: Add dedicated expression editor settings. Completion and help default on; choose Enter or Tab to accept suggestions, with Enter as the default and preferences saved.
strings.仅选中图层时，可将表达式批量应用到自选变换属性；明确选中的具体属性始终优先，兼容: When only layers are selected, batch-apply expressions to chosen transforms. Explicit property selections always take priority; handle mixed 2D/3D layers and separated Position axes.
strings.变换目标悬停展开、移开收起并保留勾选；默认全部不选，只在同次面板会话保留，重载面: Open transform targets on hover and keep choices when the pointer leaves. Start with none selected, retain choices only for the panel session and clear them on reload.
strings.标签筛选支持多选，结果须同时包含全部所选标签，并可与名称搜索组合；标签块可逐个移: Filter by multiple tags, requiring every selected tag and optionally a matching name. Remove selected tag chips individually or clear them together.
strings.保存自定义表达式时支持选择已有标签，也可输入后按 Enter 添加新标签，支持去: Choose existing tags when saving custom expressions or type new tags and press Enter. Deduplicate tags, remove them individually and discard edits on cancel.
strings.表达式选择列表与当前选中项使用名称左对齐、标签块右对齐的布局，适配中英文和窄面板: Align expression names to the left and tag chips to the right in the dropdown and selected value, with bilingual and compact layouts.
strings.下拉菜单、补全弹层和整理目录选择新增进出动画，统一跟随动画耗时倍率、关闭动画与系: Animate dropdowns, completion popups and organizer folder pickers on entry and exit, respecting the duration scale, Off and system reduced motion.
strings.整理方案新增放弃修改并还原；保存和还原按钮仅在有未保存修改时显示，非安静模式下还: Add discard and restore for organizer schemes. Show save and restore only for unsaved edits and confirm restoration unless Quiet mode is enabled.
strings.未选属性、未勾选可用目标等情况显示醒目的红色错误提示；完善属性选择同步、宿主重载: Show prominent red errors for empty property selections and unavailable targets. Improve selection synchronization, host reloads and rapidly reopened popups.
strings.首字母补全、最多 7 个候选，配合函数用途与参数说明；接受键可选 Enter 或: Complete from the first letter with up to seven suggestions and function/parameter help. Choose Enter or Tab to accept.
strings.选中图层并勾选所需变换属性，批量应用表达式；具体属性选择始终优先。: Select layers and choose their transform targets for batch expressions. Explicit property selections always take priority.
strings.多标签交集筛选，已有标签直接选择，新标签按 Enter 添加，名称与标签分列显示: Require all selected tags, reuse existing tags or add new ones with Enter. Read names and tag chips in separate columns.
strings.统一下拉与弹层动画，醒目的错误提示，整理方案支持放弃修改并还原。: Consistent dropdown and popup animations, prominent errors and discard/restore for organizer schemes.
strings.离线代码补全与参数说明，配合多标签筛选，把表达式应用到所选属性或图层变换。: Write with offline completion and parameter help, filter by multiple tags, and apply expressions to selected properties or layer transforms.
strings.所选属性或图层变换批量应用: Batch-apply to selected properties or layer transforms
strings.补全、标签筛选与图层变换，让表达式工作更顺手。: Work faster with expression completion, tag filters and layer transform targets.
